# Upcoming changes in patch 41 on January 24th, 2023 (illegal weapons & mod removal)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_114_nukaknights-post-patch41-kommende-aenderungen.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Today's patch divides the community. Most people are looking forward to healthy balancing with the upcoming change, but there are also some players who see it differently and are attached to their legacy weapons. As already mentioned several times, it would have been desirable if Bethesda had reimplemented the Energy Explo weapons and left them in the game. Reducing the explosion effect from 100% to 30% like with "normal" weapons and dividing the damage across the beam spreader would certainly have helped a lot here. But Bethesda is now taking a different approach. As we have already observed on the PTS in several patches, a legacy / hack filter has been implemented that disables all mods and legendary effects that should not be in the game. Either because they were removed by previous patches (legacy), or because they were introduced into the game through hacks (on PC).

## Legacy weapons lose their effects

Of course, this primarily concerns energy explosive weapons. For example, laser guns, Gatling plasma, Gatling lasers with exploding bullets.

Bethesda says the following:

Exploding bullets now only apply to bullets. (track gun bolt excluded)

Of course, this means that the track gun retains its exploding bullets or bolts.

However, this also means that various other legacy weapons also lose their effects, e.g. The Stalker's Melee Weapons, Quad Gatling Plasma or Dual Weapons (See post: All about Legacy Weapons).

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-pts-legacy-filter-youtube.jpg) 

## Crusader Pistol: Exploding bullets effect

Another effect of this change is that the **Crusader Pistol** will also be affected if you play the Fusion Magazine. in this case the explosion effect is then suppressed. If you convert the mod to 5.56 ammunition, pyro, cryo or standard 10mm, the exploding bullets will work again.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-pts-crusader-explosive-youtube.jpg) 

## Hack weapons will be disabled

On PC there have been some very wild outgrowths of the darkest ultracite hell in the form of hacks. e.g. Sniper Miniguns, Mirv Miniguns, Orbital Strike Rifles, Double Shot Explo Combat Knives to name a few examples. Of course, all of these weapons are completely illogical and have never dropped in the game.

On the YouTube account “Fallout Museum” you will find numerous videos of demonstrations of these curious weapons.

## Gunpowder can now be stored in the salvage crate

![](/uploads/nukaknights-pts-schiesspulver-verehrungskiste.jpg)

This is a big deal since gunpowder can always get pretty heavy and most players throw it away. Now you can store the gunpowder and you don't necessarily have to produce gunpowder when making ammunition. This of course saves material and weight in everyday life.

## Radium rifle mods are now easier to learn

This is also a big deal! Anyone who has ever tried to learn all the mods for the Radium Rifle knows what I'm talking about. The chances of learning the latest mods were so far a fraction of a percent. This resulted in some players trading tons of junk just to learn all the mods.

Bethesda writes:

Radium rifles will have an increased chance of learning mods through scrapping.

### Mr Handy Buzzblade VATS AP consumption has been drastically reduced

Most players probably won't even notice this change. Very few people play Mr Handy Buzzblade, and even fewer will play in VATS.

### Assault rifles are now correctly classified as rifles, regardless of mods
